+
+## Repeated framed-tile color connectors
+When a grid is a regular array of framed square tiles separated by uniform blank rows/columns, read the tile interiors as a smaller color matrix. Leave the tiled pattern and its dimensions intact, then connect repeated *non-dominant* interior colors in the same tile row or column by painting only the separator gap(s) between their aligned interior shapes. Do not overwrite intervening tiles; the connector resumes in later gaps. Preserve the shape's width/height in the gap (e.g. 3-cell-wide interior creates 3 colored cells per row of a horizontal gap, or 3-cell-tall per column of a vertical gap).
